reasoning.text: Reproducibility is limited mainly by the missing transform algorithm and scheduling: the spec pins all numeric parameters but supplies no DIT/DIF datapath or working conflict-free bank map, so the two impls diverge on decimation direction and both inherit a bank map that collides. Fidelity on parameters is excellent — psi=1945, omega=10302, N^-1=12277, Barrett mu=21843/k=28, q=12289, 14-bit, negacyclic all match the reference exactly — but the biggest fidelity gap is that CFNTT's signature conflict-free memory mapping is violated (and the 33%/20%/50% savings unverifiable), so the impls realize a correct generic NTT rather than the specific conflict-free architecture the paper describes.
gaps: [operation] The paper's actual conflict-free bank-index b(i) and offset o(i) functions (the headline Sec. III result); the supplied map collides for radix-2 stages s>=6
[control] Exact NTT/INTT datapath algorithm: DIT vs DIF, stride direction, twiddle ordering, in-place vs ping-pong
[operation] Radix-4 fused per-stage schedule and twiddle addressing that realize the 33%/20% op savings
[operation] Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s that routes lanes to banks each stage
[control] Schedule/FSM states, loop bounds and transitions (taken from reproduction metadata, not the paper)
[param] Twiddle-ROM contents / generator convention and stage-to-address mapping (psi=1945 is a reproduction choice)
